title: Why AI Didn't Actually Make You Ship Faster — Gabriel Spencer-Harper, Meticulous
description:
AI writes code faster than humans can review it. Verification is now your bottleneck.

Gabriel Spencer-Harper, co-founder and CEO of Meticulous, explains why assertion-based tests can't keep up with AI-generated code, and what near-exhaustive frontend verification with zero developer effort looks like. He demos how Meticulous records real user flows, replays them on every pull request and shows visual before/after diffs. He also explains the three technologies that make it work: fully mocked network traffic, a deterministic browser and coverage-guided flow selection.

In this talk:
• Why the space of possible regressions is too big for hand-written assertions
• How record-and-replay visual diffing works on every PR
• Making the browser deterministic to eliminate flaky tests
• Why code coverage finally means 'code tested' when you screenshot every step
